title: Building original glyph outlines (FontTools)
description: FontTools builds and reloads an original TrueType font. Inspect the f, i and custom fi glyph contours and control points.

prompt: Building original glyph outlines. Inspect the locally generated results and rerun the included recipe when changing simulation inputs.
